review.title: Dairy cultivation panel: bounded genus and species reference correspondences
review.independence_basis: Parent independently read the primary-source context, authored configuration, native source populations, full local and actual M5 candidate diffs and external candidate/receipt hashes before the guarded application. The unchanged shared binder, engine, gate runner and diagnostic builder have separate code reviews and mutation controls. This is self-review of the resulting scoped technical correction.
review.summary: The existing Synechocystis genus descriptor and Desertifilum tharense species descriptor now carry their exact native reference correspondences and matching statuses. No experimental stock or assembly identity is added. The four descriptors, eukaryotic exclusions, distinct cultivation treatments, source quotations, empty biological graph and historical uncertainty remain unchanged.
review.scope_description: Exactly two declared GTDB blocks/statuses, two native inline events and the actual source/application/history/gate provenance for CommunityMech:000384. This is a partial mixed-rank database-correspondence diagnostic, not a complete scientific review of the cultivation panel.
review.selection: One whole-record mixed-rank canary selected from six source-prepared records. Only CommunityMech:000384 is reviewed here; the six-record source-report denominator is preparation context, not the reviewed population. No remaining mixed or family-route application is approved by this diagnostic alone.
limitations: Partial technical review with scientific_review:false. Native technical completion does not establish full scientific review, source-snippet validation, generated-page integration, final corpus QC or campaign completion.

The native Synechocystis genus result is 8/8 filtered reference genomes. The Desertifilum tharense exact-ID species result contains one reference genome. Neither population identifies the unnamed experimental stocks or establishes that the study used a particular reference assembly.

Source examination was limited to retained data-article Methods and Table 3 passages. This pass did not newly acquire or completely review the associated research article, supplements, figure pixels, raw amplicon data or study assemblies.

Four monocultures, four paired cultures and four sequential cultures remain separate treatments. The four listed descriptors are not a universal four-member inoculum; indigenous non-sterile bacteria remain outside the exact canonical roster.
Chlorella sorokiniana and Euglena gracilis retain NO_GTDB_EQUIVALENT. Source-supported genus versus species rank, absent formal strain fields and all treatment memberships remain unchanged.

The empty ecological graph remains an unresolved research gap under the historical batch 59 assessment and issue 1537. Endpoint profiles, predicted functions and associations do not establish gene activity, exchanged flux or selective mediation. This correspondence correction makes no issue disposition.

Source reporting, binding and the first private stage ran locally at ead20c0392805c2810d49e9a57aa2fd710578145. The actual M5 stage, application and scoped gates ran at published 70ef731cc6c35d9ffe08a391c9db2b4adb10abf4 with native Python 3.13.2. Post-application receipts are not clean-tree runs. The original local candidate remains retained; its only content difference from the accepted M5 candidate is the two actual native timestamps.

The exact crosswalk hash is 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd; file mtime is not a release identifier. Local NCBI identity/rank observations are stat-bound, not full database checksum claims.

Native terms report Validation passed without an assertion denominator. Strict successor admission, historical caller checks and generated-page integration remain separate follow-up checks; technical gates do not count examined scientific assertions.

evidence.summary: The source names Synechocystis sp. and Desertifilum tharense without formal strain identifiers and assigns them to distinct mono-, paired and sequential cultivation groups. This does not establish exact reference-genome identity.

evidence.summary: NCBITaxon1142 remains genus rank with the native 8/8 Synechocystis reference population. NCBITaxon1185873 remains species rank with one exact-ID Desertifilum tharense reference genome. No new taxon label, stock or assembly assertion follows.

evidence.locator: actual before/after/input binding, two native inline events and bound appended sidecar
evidence.summary: The guarded M5 application persisted the independently accepted candidate. Its only semantic changes are the two declared correspondence blocks/statuses and native events; all biology, quotations, prior history and exclusions remain protected.

evidence.summary: The historical scientific review leaves treatment-specific interaction structure unresolved. The empty graph is not evidence that biological interactions are absent; source-grounded descriptor correspondence does not revise that assessment.

assessments.summary: The genus-only Synechocystis and named Desertifilum species descriptors retain their original scope and absent strain identifiers. All four panel descriptors and treatment memberships remain distinct.

assessments.topic: Mixed-rank reference populations without stock assignment
assessments.summary: The native 8/8 genus population and one-genome exact-ID species result establish bounded database correspondences. They do not identify study genomes, infer a four-member inoculum or change the two eukaryotic exclusions.

assessments.topic: Actual guarded transition with historical science preserved
assessments.summary: The accepted candidate was applied on the isolated frozen M5 revision, with eight scoped native commands and one appended sidecar. Old scientific uncertainty, biological predicates, source quotations and history remain unchanged; remaining mixed-route units await the complete saved canary proof.
